post.text:
A Muslim man confronted a woman on the bus for eating her lunch while he was fasting.

She weren’t having none of that … https://t.co/jRUkTjmi77
post.author_description: Patriot trying to save Britain one unfiltered post at a time.| Animal lover | meme lord | Sharing news | Great Sense of Humour | Middle Aged Moaner | Christian

description.description: A close-up of a person inside what appears to be a bus, though the figure is dark and out of focus.
description.ocrText: 5 BREAKING NEWS MAN CONFRONTS WOMAN ON BUS FOR EATING HER LUNCH WHILE HE IS FASTING

tweetMedia.transcription: Excuse me. Sorry? Yeah, I can smell that. Do you mind eating that somewhere else? I'm fasting. That's not my concern. Yeah, but I'm fasting though. So why are you out? What do you mean why am I out? If you're fasting, you should be indoors. I'm eating my lunch and you come and disturb me. Yeah, but I can smell it. So what? It's food. Of course you're going to smell it. Yeah, but can you not just wait until you get off the bus? Please, don't tell me what to do. You're fasting, stay indoors and don't come and bother nobody on the bus. No, no, but I'm just saying. I'm eating my lunch. What's your problem? I'm eating my lunch. I'm eating my lunch. What to do? You're fasting, stay indoors and don't come and bother nobody on the bus. No, no, but I'm just saying... I'm eating my lunch. What's your problem? Because you're right next to me and I can smell it. But go downstairs. Don't you think you should have manners and not eat inside the bus? Go downstairs and leave me alone. It's my lunch. Yeah, but I can smell it. I'm fasting and I can smell it. That's your business. Stay indoors. What do you mean stay indoors? I need to go out and smell this stuff. I don't go out. Stay indoors, read your Bible and keep quiet. Well, first of all, I don't read the Bible. Second of all, just because you stay inside when you're fasting doesn't mean I need to do that as well. Well, you shouldn't be coming like this. I can trouble with it.
